name: The Ultimate Fighter 22: Team McGregor vs. Team Faber

_provenance.note: The finale bout is reconciled against our own ufc_events / ufc_bouts records and is NOT imported: we already hold that card. Everything inside the house exists only here.

_conflicts.detail: The source's preliminary-round table is internally inconsistent — it lists Ryan Hall vs Frantz Slioa as both an elimination bout and a quarter-final, and pairs cast members against each other in a round that is supposed to be cast members against outsiders. The entry round is therefore recorded as UNVERIFIED and no elimination bouts are asserted. The bracket from the announced quarter-finals onward is internally consistent and is recorded.

classification_policy.rationale: Bouts filmed in the TUF house are unsanctioned exhibitions and do not appear on a fighter's professional record. The finale is a sanctioned bout on a UFC card and does. Each bout below carries its own classification explicitly — none is inferred from the TUF label, and anything we cannot establish is 'unverified' rather than assumed either way.

roster.name: Martin Svensson
roster.note: Withdrew from the tournament with a broken elbow.

roster.name: Saul Rogers
roster.note: Reached the final but was pulled from the card over a visa application.

roster.name: Artem Lobov
roster.note: Returned to the tournament after an earlier elimination.

roster.name: Chris Gruetzemacher
roster.note: Entered the quarter-finals as a replacement for Martin Svensson.

roster.name: Ryan Hall
roster.note: Lost in the quarter-finals, then replaced Saul Rogers in the final and won the tournament.

roster.name: Johnny Nuñez
roster.note: Returned to the tournament after an earlier elimination.

stages.label: Entry round
stages.note: Not asserted: the source's account of this round contradicts itself. See _conflicts.

stages.label: Quarter-finals
stages.note: Announced in episode 9 as Lobov v Svensson, Rogers v Hall, Wrzosek v Teymur, Lloveras v Erosa. Svensson withdrew with a broken elbow and Chris Gruetzemacher took his place.

stages.label: Tournament final
stages.note: Saul Rogers won his way to the final and was then pulled from the card over his visa application. Ryan Hall, who had lost to Rogers in the quarter-finals, replaced him and won the tournament.

bouts.classification_basis: sanctioned bout on a UFC card

finale.event_name: The Ultimate Fighter: Team McGregor vs. Team Faber Finale

finale.link_policy: Resolved against our own ufc_events row by name and date. The card's bouts already exist in ufc_bouts and are NOT re-imported; the season page reads them from the database so there is exactly one copy of every professional result.

champions.contract_note: Winning the tournament and being awarded a UFC contract are recorded separately, because they are not the same thing and have not always gone together.
